page.intro: Connect an AI service with your own API key, choose a model for each job, add prices and set spending limits. Each part is saved on its own.
page.loadFailed: AI services couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
status.onDetail: The jobs your course needs have a working connection, a model, prices and spending limits.
status.noLearnerLimit: Learners have no limit of their own; the workspace total applies.
issue.keyProblem: {count, plural, one {# connection has a key problem} other {# connections have a key problem}}
issue.models: {count, plural, one {# job needs a model} two {# jobs need a model} other {# jobs need a model}}
issue.check: {count, plural, one {# model is waiting for a quality check} two {# models are waiting for a quality check} other {# models are waiting for a quality check}}
issue.notOn: your model choices aren't turned on yet
issue.prices: {count, plural, one {# model needs a price} two {# models need a price} other {# models need a price}}
issue.learnerLimit: nothing is chosen yet for each learner's spending (a limit, or no limit)
connect.title: Connect an AI service
connect.intro: Course Core uses your own API key. It is stored encrypted on this server and is never shown again.
connect.keyHelp.google: Create a key in Google AI Studio
connect.keyHelp.anthropic: Create a key in the Anthropic Console
connect.testOk: Key works. {service} offers {count, plural, one {# model} two {# models} other {# models}} to this key.
connect.nameHint: Helps you tell connections apart, for example “Google – school account”.
connect.errRejected: {service} rejected this key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one.
connect.errForbidden: This key works but isn't allowed to use the {service} API. Turn the API on for the key's project, then try again.
connect.errQuota: {service} says this key has no remaining quota or billing isn't set up. Check billing in your {service} account.
connect.errUnreachable: This server couldn't reach {service}. Check its internet access or proxy settings, then try again.
connect.errRateLimited: Too many key checks in the last hour. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} two {# minutes} other {# minutes}}.
connect.errMalformed: This doesn't look like an API key. It contains spaces or characters a key can't have.
connect.errUnexpected: The key check didn't finish. Try again; nothing was saved.
connect.saveUntestedWarn: The key will be saved untested. AI help will fail until it works.
keyChars.summary: {count, plural, one {This key has a character that API keys never contain.} other {This key has # characters that API keys never contain.}} Apps that auto-format text sometimes swap or add them.
keyChars.letter: Character {position, number} is <char>{shown}</char> ({name}), not the letter <char>{plain}</char>.
keyChars.digit: Character {position, number} is <char>{shown}</char> ({name}), not the digit <char>{plain}</char>.
keyChars.hyphen: Character {position, number} is <char>{shown}</char> ({name}), not a plain hyphen <char>{plain}</char>.
keyChars.symbol: Character {position, number} is <char>{shown}</char> ({name}), not a plain <char>{plain}</char>.
keyChars.quote: Character {position, number} is <char>{shown}</char> ({name}). API keys never contain quotation marks.
keyChars.other: Character {position, number} is {shown} ({codePoint}), which API keys never contain.
keyChars.otherHidden: Character {position, number} is an invisible control character ({codePoint}).
keyChars.more: And {count, plural, one {# more character} other {# more characters}}.
keyChars.recopy.google: Copy the key again with the copy button in Google AI Studio, and paste it straight here.
keyChars.recopy.anthropic: Copy the key again with the copy button in the Anthropic Console, and paste it straight here.
keyChars.recopy.other: Copy the key again with the copy button where you created it, and paste it straight here.
keyChars.fix: {count, plural, one {Fix this character} other {Fix these characters}}
keyChars.fixHint: Replaces look-alike characters with the plain ones and removes invisible ones. The key is then checked again.
keyChars.fixPartial: {count, plural, one {The other character can't be fixed here.} other {The other # characters can't be fixed here.}} Copy the key again for those.
keyChars.saveBlocked: Saving is off until the key has only characters an API key can have.
row.replaceNote: The new key replaces the old one for every model using this connection. Jobs already running finish with the old key.
row.removeBody: {name} and its key are deleted from this server. This can't be undone.
row.inUse: {jobs} use this connection. Choose other models for them first.
role.companion.name: Learner tutor
role.companion.purpose: Chats with learners about the lesson.
role.supervisor.name: Lesson planner
role.supervisor.purpose: Decides what each learner does next and when to review.
role.research.name: Source finder
role.research.purpose: Finds and summarises outside sources for staff to approve.
role.reviewer.name: Answer review drafts
role.reviewer.purpose: Drafts feedback on written answers for staff to review.
role.media.name: Images and video
role.media.purpose: Makes illustrations or short clips for staff to review.
models.intro: We picked a suggestion for each job your course uses. You can change them later.
models.basis: Suggestions are based on the model list your service reports. The quality check below tries them out.
models.optional: {count, plural, one {Optional job (#)} two {Optional jobs (#)} other {Optional jobs (#)}}
models.why.companion: Fast and low-cost for frequent chat.
models.why.supervisor: Fast and low-cost; it runs after each step a learner takes.
models.why.research: Low-cost; it looks up sources now and then for staff to approve.
models.why.reviewer: Stronger model; it runs rarely and staff review it.
models.why.media: Off by default. Turn it on only if your course makes images or video.
models.mayNotWork: May not work for this job
models.listFailed: The model list couldn't be loaded.
models.videoNote: Check these against the model's documentation.
models.imageModelHint: Short videos use the model above. Choose a model here if your course also needs images. Staff review every image and video before learners see them.
models.savedWaiting: Models saved. {count, plural, one {# model needs} two {# models need} other {# models need}} a quality check before it turns on. See Quality check below.
models.pending: Your new choices are saved but not on yet. Learners still get the models that are on now.
models.errVideo: Fill in the video settings, or choose Image.
prices.intro: Prices change, so check them. For models Course Core knows, the fields are filled in from {service}'s pricing page; confirm them and save. For other models, copy them from {service}'s pricing page.
prices.fromTable: From {service}'s pricing page, checked {date} — confirm these prices, then save.
prices.tierNote: For prompts up to {tokens, number} tokens. Longer prompts cost more.
prices.changeNote: {service} changes this price on {date}: {input} input and {output} output per 1M tokens.
prices.changeSaved: Saving also records the new price from that date.
prices.changeUpdate: Save the new price here before that date.
prices.nothing: Prices appear here after you choose models.
prices.missingNote: Until you add prices, these jobs stay off.
prices.errBoth: Enter the input price, or leave both prices empty
prices.errSource: Say where the prices come from
prices.scheduledTokens: Scheduled change from {date}: {input} input and {output} output per 1M tokens.
prices.scheduledOther: Scheduled change from {date}: other prices are saved for this model from that date.
prices.scheduledWithdrawn: Scheduled change from {date}: this model has no price from then, so its jobs stop.
prices.previewUntil: Saving applies these prices from now until {date}. Then the scheduled change applies.
prices.dialogIntro: These prices replace the change scheduled for {date}.
prices.dialogPreviewTokens: Until {date} the current price stays. From {date}: {input} input and {output} output per 1M tokens.
prices.dialogPreview: Until {date} the current price stays. From {date}, the prices above apply.
prices.errNone: Enter a price, or use “Keep the current price” instead
prices.keepBody: The price in force before {date} stays after that date. Nothing else changes.
prices.keepSource: Change scheduled for {date} removed; the earlier price stays
prices.kept: The change scheduled for {date} was removed. The current price stays.
spending.perLearnerHint: Applies to every learner who doesn't have their own limit.
spending.perRequestSummary: {amount} · up to {minutes, plural, one {# minute} two {# minutes} other {# minutes}}
spending.note: When a limit is reached, AI help pauses for that workspace or learner until you raise it. {service}'s own billing is separate.
spending.noteGeneric: When a limit is reached, AI help pauses for that workspace or learner until you raise it. Your AI service's own billing is separate.
spending.consent: Pressing the button records your consent to spend up to this amount on AI calls.
spending.errLearnerMore: The limit for each learner can't be more than the total
spending.errBelowUsage: This is less than what's already been used ({used}).
spending.learnerLimitOption: Limit each learner to an amount
spending.learnerNoneOption: No limit per learner (the workspace total still applies)
spending.learnerNoneMeans: Any learner can use AI help until the workspace total of {total} is used up. Daily, per-lesson and individual limits you set for a learner still apply. Use this while you see what learners really spend, then choose a limit from “What learners spend” below.
spending.learnerNoneMeansGeneric: Any learner can use AI help until the workspace total is used up. Daily, per-lesson and individual limits you set for a learner still apply. Use this while you see what learners really spend, then choose a limit from “What learners spend” below.
spending.consentNoLearnerLimit: Pressing the button records your consent to spend up to the total on AI calls, with no separate limit for each learner.
spending.savedNoLearnerLimit: Spending limits saved. Learners have no limit of their own; the workspace total applies.
history.title: Spending so far
history.note: Course Core's own records, not an invoice. Periods are in UTC.
unknown.title: Calls with an unknown cost
unknown.intro: {count, plural, one {One AI call was sent but never reported what it used} other {# AI calls were sent but never reported what they used}}: no reply came back in time, or the reply stopped before the AI service said how much it used. The service may or may not have charged for {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Until you decide, Course Core counts the most each call could cost against your limits ({amount} in all).
unknown.howTo: Check your AI service's usage page at the time of each call, then decide what counts. Your decision is final and is recorded in the audit log.
unknown.happened.noResponse: Sent, but the AI service sent nothing back in time.
unknown.happened.stopped: Stopped when its question was cancelled, before the AI service said how much it used.
unknown.happened.stalled: The reply stopped coming part way, before the AI service said how much it used.
unknown.happened.serviceError: The AI service failed after the request was sent.
unknown.happened.noReceipt: Contact with the AI service was lost before anything about the call was recorded.
unknown.notYet: Still settling. Course Core waits up to {minutes} minutes in case the call's result arrives; you can decide after that.
unknown.question: What should count for this call?
unknown.zero: {zero}: the usage page shows no charge for it ({amount} goes back to the limits)
unknown.keep: {amount}: the service charged for it, or you can't tell
unknown.reasonHint: For example: the usage page shows no request at that time.
unknown.errDecision: Choose what counts for this call
unknown.errReason: Say what you checked (at least 3 characters)
unknown.errSettling: This call is still being settled. Try again in a few minutes; nothing was changed.
unknown.errChanged: This call was already decided or changed. The list is up to date now; nothing else was changed.
unknown.savedZero: Counted as {zero}. {amount} went back to the limits.
unknown.savedKept: Kept: {amount} stays counted and is no longer held.
unknown.more: More calls are waiting. Decide these first to see the rest.
learnerSpend.title: What learners spend
learnerSpend.intro: Real AI spending by learners, to help you choose a limit for each learner. Learners are shown by enrollment, never by name.
learnerSpend.lastDays: Last {days, plural, one {day} two {2 days} other {# days}}
learnerSpend.empty: No learner used paid AI help in this period.
learnerSpend.actual: From the AI service's reported usage
learnerSpend.learnerSummary: Learner {learner} · {course} · {amount} · {days, plural, one {# active day} two {# active days} other {# active days}}
learnerSpend.note: Course Core's own records, not an invoice. Days are UTC days. An active hour is an hour in which the learner did something in the course or used AI help.
learnerSpend.rec.title: Suggested limit for each learner
learnerSpend.rec.notEnough: Not enough data yet ({learners, plural, one {# learner} two {# learners} other {# learners}}, {days, plural, one {# day} two {# days} other {# days}}). A suggestion appears once at least {minLearners} learners have used AI on {minDays} learner-days in this period.
learnerSpend.rec.why: In the last {windowDays} days, 9 in 10 learners spent at most {p90} each. Adding {margin}% headroom and rounding up gives {amount}: a typical heavy learner keeps going, while unusual use stops.
learnerSpend.rec.capped: That would be more than the workspace total, so the suggestion is the total, {amount}.
learnerSpend.rec.daily: For comparison, 9 in 10 learner-days cost at most {p90Day}; with the same headroom a daily limit would be {daily}.
learnerSpend.rec.use: Use {amount} as the limit for each learner
learnerSpend.rec.saved: The limit for each learner is now {amount}.
learnerSpend.rec.current: This is already the limit for each learner.
learnerSpend.rec.consent: Pressing the button records your consent to let each learner spend up to this amount on AI calls.
check.notChecked: {count, plural, one {This model hasn't been checked yet:} two {These models haven't been checked yet:} other {These models haven't been checked yet:}}
check.nothingWaiting: No model is waiting for a check.
check.explain: The quality check runs {dialogues, plural, one {# practice conversation} two {# practice conversations} other {# practice conversations}} with your models and checks that replies follow the teaching rules. It uses your key and budget.
check.run.title: Run the quality check
check.run.reserve: While it runs, up to {amount} is set aside from the workspace spending limit. What isn't used goes back.
check.run.canLeave: You can leave this page. The check keeps running.
check.run.jobPassed: {job}: passed all {count, plural, one {# conversation} two {# conversations} other {# conversations}}.
check.run.jobFailed: {job}: {failed} of {count, plural, one {# conversation} two {# conversations} other {# conversations}} broke a rule:
check.run.timeout: It took too long and was stopped. Try again later.
check.run.interrupted: The server stopped while it ran. Run it again.
check.run.failedToRun: Something went wrong while it ran. Try again.
check.run.passedTurnOn: Ready to turn on. Learners get these models once you turn them on.
check.run.noDraft: Choose models first. There is nothing to check yet.
check.run.alreadyRunning: A check is already running. Wait for it to finish.
check.run.pricesMissing: Save a price for {jobs} first (see Prices). The check needs it to know what it costs.
check.run.pricesMissingGeneric: Save the model prices first (see Prices). The check needs them to know what it costs.
check.run.limitMissing: Set a total spending limit first (see Spending). The check counts against it.
check.run.budgetReached: The workspace spending limit doesn't have enough left. The check sets aside {needed} and {available} is left. Raise the limit in Spending.
check.run.budgetReachedGeneric: The workspace spending limit doesn't have enough left for the check. Raise the limit in Spending.
check.run.keyMissing: The key for these models is missing. Add the key again in Connections.
check.run.rateLimited: Too many checks in the last hour. Try again later.
check.rule.hint_leakage: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it gave away the answer instead of a hint
check.rule.grounding: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it went beyond the lesson material
check.rule.diagnosis_restraint: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it labelled the learner (for example, called them confused)
check.rule.factuality: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it got a fact from the lesson wrong
check.rule.authority: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it claimed powers it doesn't have, revealed its instructions or asked for private details
check.rule.tool_scope: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it used a tool it isn't allowed to use
check.rule.quotes: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it marked a rubric item as met without quoting the learner's own words
check.rule.citations: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, it cited too few sources
check.rule.privacy: {count, plural, one {In # conversation} two {In # conversations} other {In # conversations}}, a learner's private details reached the request or the reply
check.approveNote: Use this only if you can't run the check. The models turn on without being tried.
check.approveOwnersOnly: Only an owner can approve without checking. Ask an owner, or run the check.
check.reasonLabel: Why are you skipping the check?
check.reasonHint: At least 20 characters. Saved in the audit log with your name.
check.errReason: Write at least 20 characters about why you're skipping the check.
check.disclaimer: The check is a set of rules, not proof of teaching quality.
check.state.not_covered: No automatic check for this job — keeps working; needs an owner's approval before its model changes
check.state.not_evaluated: Not checked yet — keeps working; needs a check before its model changes
check.state.failed: Didn't pass the latest check — keeps working
check.state.stale: Needs a new check — the checks changed since it was checked or approved; keeps working
check.active.note: {count, plural, one {# job is on but hasn't passed the current quality checks.} two {# jobs are on but haven't passed the current quality checks.} other {# jobs are on but haven't passed the current quality checks.}} They keep working as they are. Before you can change their model, they need a quality check or an owner's approval.
check.active.draftOpen: You have model changes that aren't turned on yet. Turn them on or discard them to check the jobs that are on.
check.active.notCheckable: The quality check doesn't cover {jobs}. An owner can approve them below.
check.active.approveTitle: Approve the jobs that are on without checking
check.active.approveNote: Use this only if you can't run the check. It records that you accept these jobs as they are now. It doesn't change them.
check.active.approved: Approved. These jobs keep working as they are.
confirm.title: Stop unfinished jobs?
confirm.body: Turning this on stops {count, plural, one {# unfinished job} two {# unfinished jobs} other {# unfinished jobs}}. Calls already sent may still finish and be charged.
advanced.intro: For developers and unusual setups. Changes here skip the guided checks above, but the server still enforces the quality check and spending limits.
advanced.configNote: Each connection stores its key in its own encrypted slot on the server (shown here as COURSE_PROVIDER_…_API_KEY). You never need to type this name. No key is ever part of this configuration.
advanced.roleIds: Job ids: companion (Learner tutor), supervisor (Lesson planner), research (Source finder), reviewer (Answer review drafts), media (Images and video). Setup version {revision}.
advanced.jsonWaiting: Configuration saved as a draft. It turns on after the quality check (see Quality check).
advanced.limitsInvalid: Enter whole numbers within the allowed range.
advanced.fallbackLabel: If the subscription {name} runs out, use an API key instead
advanced.youtubeHint: Lets staff search YouTube for course sources.
advanced.requirePricing: Refuse paid work for models without a price
advanced.requirePricingAck: I understand that without a price each call is charged at its full per-request limit.
advanced.historyEmpty: No quality-check results or approvals yet.
advanced.cli: Run the check from the command line with npm run eval:agents in services/api, then upload the report with POST …/provider-evals/results.
err.stale: Someone else changed AI services since you opened this page. Reload to see their changes; your choices in this section are kept.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to change AI services. Ask a workspace owner.
err.unavailable: The server couldn't be reached. Your changes are still here. Try again.
err.generic: That didn't work. Try again; nothing was changed.
err.evalRequired: These models need a quality check or an owner's approval before they turn on.
err.evalRequiredJobs: {jobs} need a quality check or an owner's approval before this change can be saved. They keep working as they are now.
err.connectionInUse: {jobs} use this connection. Choose other models for them first.
err.budgetBelowUsage: A limit can't be lower than what's already been used.
err.consent: Press the spending button to give consent.
err.tooSmall: The limit for each request is too small for these models. Raise it in Advanced.
err.modelUnavailable: That model isn't in the service's model list any more. Choose another one.
err.contextTooSmall: This model can't take enough text for the lesson planner. Choose a model with a larger input limit.
err.configInvalid: The configuration isn't valid. Check it and try again.
err.secretField: The configuration contains a field that looks like a key or password. Keys go in Connections, never in the configuration.
err.pricingDate: A new price can't start before {earliest}, when the price in force now started, or after {latest}. Nothing was saved.
err.pricingDateLatest: A new price can't start after {latest}, a year from today. Nothing was saved.
err.pricingDateGeneric: That start date isn't allowed for this price. Nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.
err.pricingUnknownModel: This model isn't in your setup any more. Reload the page; nothing was saved.
err.pricingInvalid: These prices aren't valid. Check the amounts and try again; nothing was saved.
readonly.body: Only workspace owners and administrators can change AI services. Ask one of them if something needs to change.
readonly.demo: This is the demo. AI services are set up on a connected server.
check.hostFile.title: Setup from the server's provider file
check.hostFile.body: This workspace has no AI services setup of its own, so jobs use the provider file the server was started with. Its jobs are checked like yours: run the quality check or approve them here.
check.hostFile.unchecked: Not checked yet: {jobs}. They keep working.
check.course.title: Course-specific setups
check.course.body: A course can ask for a narrower version of a job, for example fewer tools or shorter answers. Each one needs its own check or an owner's approval. Until then that job is turned down for the course's learners; the standard job is never used in its place.
check.course.state.not_covered: Waiting for an owner's approval — turned down for this course's learners until then
check.course.approveNote: There is no automatic check for course-specific setups yet. Read what the course asks for in its release notes, then approve. The approval covers this exact setup; a new course version or a model change needs a new one.
check.course.approve: {count, plural, one {Approve this setup} other {Approve these # setups}}
check.course.approved: Approved. The course's learners get these setups from now on.
check.flag.list: Jobs that are on and need a quality check
check.flag.approveInstead: The quality check doesn't cover this job. It keeps working as it is. An owner can approve it in AI services, under Quality check.
check.flag.estimate: Checks this job only, with {count, plural, one {# practice conversation} two {# practice conversations} other {# practice conversations}}. Uses your key. About {amount}.
check.flag.allTitle: Or check all of them at once
